title: Character illustration style
slide_intent: Teach illustrators which features make an abstract figure read as part of the same family. Silhouette, line weight and pose have to work together.
strategic_value: The brand can connect its geometric illustration vocabulary to human scenes across different subjects and situations.
demonstration: A figure holding a megaphone is annotated from head to legs; two smaller watchouts show how to treat a front-facing character and the surrounding setting.
practical_value: Check a new figure against the annotated features, including two to four colors, a few heavy outline strokes and lighter detail lines. Bring a front-facing head closer to the body.

content_islands.name: Construction guidance
content_islands.spec: Set the purpose and resource note in the left column with the small watchout examples beneath.

content_islands.name: Annotated character
content_islands.spec: Isolate the full figure on white. Draw fine leader lines from facial treatment, body shapes, lines, colors and pattern to the corresponding notes.
